findings.claim: The packed API artifact checker does not reject extra package entries in packed-inventory.json, so stale or unpublic package references can remain certified.
findings.evidence: The new checker builds expectedPackages from PUBLIC_PACKAGES and only iterates `for (const [index, expected] of expectedPackages.entries())` comparing fields at those indexes; there is no assertion that `apiInventory.packages.length === expectedPackages.length` before or after the loop, while RELEASING.md claims Pages validates packed artifact inventories and tracked public-package inputs through `docs:artifacts:check`.
findings.suggested_fix: Assert the inventory length equals PUBLIC_PACKAGES length and preferably compare package names as a set/order contract before hashing the fingerprint.
